Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very sleepy and much more tired. So, she went to bed early and fell asleep. After a week, she went to move her body, but she couldn't sleep because her trunk was wet.

Lily's mom came into the room and saw that Lily was still sleepy. She asked her, "Did you stretch so well?" Lily replied, "Yes, Mommy! I kicked my head in the wet chair." Her mom smiled and said, "That's a good alligator. You're becoming a good helper." From then on,
